transformations: Read each XYZ member sequentially from the original tar.bz2 archive.
Use the source record's first SMILES and InChI fields; preserve source IDs independently.
Sanitize source SMILES with RDKit and produce canonical isomeric and non-isomeric SMILES.
Do not merge records by canonical structure.

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one carbon atom occurs in the molecular formula.
feature_registry.dependencies: Every QM9 entity contains carbon by domain construction.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit atom identity in the sanitized source-SMILES graph.
feature_registry.name: Contains carbon

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: The molecular formula contains at least one hydrogen atom, including implicit hydrogens.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit molecular formula from sanitized source-SMILES graph.
feature_registry.graph_predicate: CalcMolFormula(mol) has H count > 0; explicit hydrogen graph nodes are counted separately in the manifest.
feature_registry.hydrogen_semantics: Includes implicit and explicit hydrogen atoms; distinct manifest fields preserve explicit-node and implicit-count values.
feature_registry.name: Contains hydrogen
feature_registry.semantic_key: CalcMolFormula(mol) has H count > 0; explicit hydrogen graph nodes are counted separately in the manifest.

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one nitrogen atom occurs in the molecular graph.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit atom identity in the sanitized source-SMILES graph.
feature_registry.name: Contains nitrogen

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one oxygen atom occurs in the molecular graph.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit atom identity in the sanitized source-SMILES graph.
feature_registry.name: Contains oxygen

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one fluorine atom occurs in the molecular graph.
feature_registry.dependencies: Within QM9, halogen presence is fluorine presence; implies contains_heteroatom.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit atom identity in the sanitized source-SMILES graph.
feature_registry.name: Contains fluorine

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one atom other than carbon or hydrogen occurs in the molecular graph.
feature_registry.dependencies: In QM9 this is exactly the union of nitrogen, oxygen, and fluorine presence.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit atom identities in the sanitized source-SMILES graph.
feature_registry.graph_predicate: Any atom with atomic number outside {1, 6}.
feature_registry.hydrogen_semantics: Hydrogen is excluded whether explicit or implicit.
feature_registry.name: Contains heteroatom
feature_registry.semantic_key: Any atom with atomic number outside {1, 6}.

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one atom belongs to a cycle in the sanitized molecular graph.
feature_registry.dependencies: Aromatic ring implies ring; implication does not make predicates equivalent.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit ring-membership query after aromaticity and sanitization.
feature_registry.hydrogen_semantics: Hydrogens do not determine ring membership.
feature_registry.name: Contains a ring

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one aromatic atom belongs to a ring in the sanitized molecular graph.
feature_registry.dependencies: Chemically implies contains_ring under the stated graph semantics.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit aromaticity model and ring-membership perception.
feature_registry.name: Contains an aromatic ring

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one sanitized graph bond has RDKit bond order 2.0.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit bond-order query; aromatic bonds are not counted as double bonds.
feature_registry.name: Contains a double bond

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one sanitized graph bond has RDKit bond order 3.0.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit bond-order query.
feature_registry.name: Contains a triple bond

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: At least one sanitized graph bond has bond order greater than 1.0; aromatic bonds are excluded.
feature_registry.dependencies: Contains_double_bond and contains_triple_bond each imply this feature.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit bond types in the sanitized source-SMILES graph.
feature_registry.graph_predicate: Any non-aromatic bond with RDKit bond order > 1.0.
feature_registry.name: Contains a multiple bond
feature_registry.semantic_key: Any non-aromatic bond with RDKit bond order > 1.0.

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: A carbon atom is double-bonded to an oxygen atom.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit SMARTS substructure match.
feature_registry.name: Contains a carbonyl

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: An oxygen atom has one hydrogen and is single-bonded to carbon; this excludes water-like O-H groups.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit SMARTS with hydrogen count evaluated on a sanitized graph.
feature_registry.hydrogen_semantics: H1 includes implicit or explicit attached hydrogen as interpreted by RDKit SMARTS.
feature_registry.name: Contains a hydroxyl group

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: A carbon atom is triple-bonded to a nitrogen atom.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit SMARTS substructure match.
feature_registry.name: Contains a nitrile

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: A neutral, trivalent nitrogen atom not directly bonded to a carbonyl carbon; excludes amide nitrogen and nitrile nitrogen.
feature_registry.dependencies: Implies contains_nitrogen; does not claim that every amine-like chemical class is covered.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit SMARTS; includes primary, secondary, and tertiary amine centers meeting the predicate.
feature_registry.hydrogen_semantics: Hydrogen counts are not used; valence and graph neighborhood define the center.
feature_registry.name: Contains an amine center

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: A nitrogen is single-bonded to a carbonyl carbon.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit SMARTS substructure match.
feature_registry.name: Contains an amide

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: A carbonyl carbon is single-bonded to an oxygen which is single-bonded to carbon.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit SMARTS substructure match.
feature_registry.name: Contains an ester

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: A carbonyl carbon is bonded to a hydroxyl oxygen.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit SMARTS substructure match.
feature_registry.hydrogen_semantics: The hydroxyl oxygen may carry an implicit or explicit hydrogen.
feature_registry.name: Contains a carboxylic acid

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: An oxygen with two single bonds links two tetrahedral carbon atoms (C(sp3)-O-C(sp3)); esters are excluded by construction.
feature_registry.dependencies: Implies contains_oxygen; this narrow predicate is not a definition of every ether class.
feature_registry.derivation: RDKit SMARTS substructure match.
feature_registry.name: Contains a saturated ether linkage

feature_registry.aromaticity_and_sanitization: RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitization and default aromaticity model.
feature_registry.definition: The sum of RDKit formal charges over all atoms is nonzero.
feature_registry.dependencies: QM9 records are conventionally neutral; observed variance is measured, not assumed.
feature_registry.derivation: Formal charge encoded in the source SMILES and sanitized graph.
feature_registry.name: Has nonzero formal charge
